top_choice_rationale: P001 (B014: Calvo, Taylor, Woodford) credits three separable, identifiable contributions: the tractable pricing friction, staggered contracts with the policy rule, and the welfare-based synthesis. The work is 25 to 40 years old, has been extended rather than abandoned after 2008, the zero lower bound and 2021-23, and no earlier prize recognised the nominal-rigidity and policy-rule core. The citation should name these mechanisms and not claim the estimated-DSGE tradition. Attribution is the real cost, because Galí, Christiano, Eichenbaum, Evans, Smets, Wouters and Gertler are left out. I judge the gap to P002 (Kiyotaki-Moore, cleaner attribution but a theory-led original paper with narrower footprint) to be modest. I rank P002 above no award. P000 is last because P001 and P002 are both mature, original and creditable.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no co-authorship or institutional link to Calvo, Taylor, Woodford, Kiyotaki or Moore. Institutional overlap with Hassler and Krusell at Stockholm (2010-17) is not a candidate connection.
